intro: Sample content: replace this with your real culture statement.

items.title: Own the outcome
items.description: Teams decide how to solve a problem and stay accountable for the result.

items.title: Learn in the open
items.description: We share what worked and what didn't, in writing, so others can build on it.

items.title: Respect people's time
items.description: Meetings have an agenda. Decisions are written down.

items.title: Flexible hours
items.description: Core overlap hours are agreed per team. The rest is up to you.

items.title: Regular feedback
items.description: Short check-ins every month, formal reviews twice a year.
